title: Perampanel as add-on therapy in epilepsy treatment: PERBONN, a retrospective long-term real-world study
summary:
We want to better understand how the drug perampanel (PER) works when used in addition to other drugs in people with epilepsy in their normal everyday lives. We are interested in the following questions:
1. How long is PER continued to be used and how do doctors and patients assess its effect over a longer period of time in everyday life?
2. Which personal and disease-related factors influence the outcome?
3. How does the total amount of all antiepileptic drugs, i.e., the total dose, affect treatment adherence, efficacy, and possible side effects of PER when it is used as an adjunctive treatment for difficult-to-treat epilepsy?

interventions.name: Adult patients who were treated with perampanel (PER) as adjunctive therapy for the first time between August 1, 2012, and August 1, 2016.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Adult patients who were administered perampanel (PER) as adjunctive therapy for the first time at our clinic between August 1, 2012, and August 1, 2016.
Exclusion criteria:
Age under 18 years, no additional medication with perampanel
